div.head: Grið 20
div.ab: Se þe oferhogie þæt he heom hlyste, hæbbe him gemæne þæt wið God sylfne.
Se þe oferhogie þæt he heom hlyste, hæbbe him gemæne þæt wið God sylfne.
Wer verschmäht, auf sie zu hören, habe das zu verantworten bei Gott selbst.
Whoever scorns to listen to them, let him answer for it to God himself.
Anyone who rejects what he hears from them must settle his dispute with God himself.
div.note: Liebermann compares I Cn 26.; T: corrected against Rabin, DOML 66 (2020), p. 26 (before: ‘Se þe oferhogie þæt he heom hlyste, hæbbe him gemaene þæt wið God sylfne.’)
